%@ 个账户超过 %@ 天未做余额核对：%@: %@ accounts not reconciled for over %@ days: %@
%@ 今天到期，记得还款并在 App 中入账: %@ is due today. Remember to pay and record it.
%@ 今天到期，账本中当前欠款 %@: %@ is due today; the ledger shows %@ owed.
%@ 已存在余额断言: A balance assertion already exists on %@
%@ 已存在：将把本账户的全部记录并入该账户，并移除本账户的开户 / 关户指令。: %@ already exists: all entries of this account will be merged into it and this account's open / close directives removed. Its balance assertions move along and may need re-checking.
%@ 笔已选交易还没有科目或付款账户: %@ selected rows still need an account
Beancount 余额断言在当日开始时校验；断言日期设为明天，即核对今日日终余: Beancount checks a balance assertion at the start of its date; dating it tomorrow checks today's closing balance.
GitHub 上的文件已被修改（%@），稍后将自动重试: The file was changed on GitHub (%@); will retry automatically
主题色用于按钮、选中状态与图表；收入与亏损分别固定以绿色与红色表示。: The theme color is used for buttons, selections and charts; income and losses are always green and red.
仅显示前 %@ 行；导出 CSV 可获得完整结果。: Showing the first %@ rows; export CSV for the full result.
从 Yahoo Finance 获取最新价格: Fetch Latest Prices from Yahoo Finance
从支付宝、微信或银行导出账单文件，选择后会逐笔匹配科目与付款账户，并标出账本里已: Pick a bill exported from Alipay, WeChat Pay or your bank. Each line is matched to an account and payment method, and lines already in the ledger are flagged.
从本机移除「%@」？账本文件本身不受影响。: Remove “%@” from this device? The ledger files are not affected.
保存在本机，显示在「我的查询」中。: Saved on this device under My Queries.
修改会直接替换原来的 open 指令，保留其他元数据。: Saving replaces the original open directive in place and keeps its other metadata.
修改日期、币种或金额后保存，原断言（%@ %@）将被替换，不会产生重复记录。: After changing the date, currency or amount, saving replaces the original assertion (%@ %@) without creating a duplicate.
全部科目余额与借贷平衡校验: All account balances and debit/credit check
共 %@ 笔，已选 %@ 笔；%@ 笔疑似已记账（默认不选）；跳过 %@ 行（交: %@ lines, %@ selected; %@ look already recorded (unselected); %@ rows skipped (closed, failed or unreadable). Neutral transfers are unselected by default.
关闭后历史记录保留；账户默认不在账户页显示。: History is kept; closed accounts are hidden on the Accounts page by default.
内置查询（修改后可另存）: Built-in (save a copy to keep changes)
写入开户指令最多的文件。显示名称保存为 name 元数据，App 会显示在账户名: Written to the file with the most open directives. The display name is saved as name metadata and shown next to the account.
写入订单号（order 元数据，用于去重）: Write order ids (order metadata, for de-duplication)
包含所有子科目，例如 Expenses:Food 也统计 Expenses:Fo: Includes sub-accounts: Expenses:Food also counts Expenses:Food:Drinks. A later budget entry replaces an earlier one.
原交易已在 GitHub 上被修改，本次%@未提交: The original entry was changed on GitHub; this %@ was not committed
只会写入填写了新价格的项目，每项一条 price 指令。: Only rows with a new price are written, one price directive each.
只会写入填写了新价格的项目，每项一条 price 指令。证券代码可在 commo: Only rows with a new price are written, one price directive each. Set a ticker with the commodity's price metadata, e.g. price: "USD:yahoo/VOO" or "CNY:yahoo/510300.SS"; currencies use USDCNY=X.
只替换完全相同的科目，不影响其子科目。: Only the exact account is replaced, not its sub-accounts.
同一天已有余额断言: Balance assertions already exist on the same day
启用后，打开应用或从后台返回时需验证%@；在多任务界面中隐藏账本内容。: When on, %@ is required on launch and when returning from the background; the ledger is hidden in the app switcher.
固定交易本月未入账: Recurring items not recorded this month
在 GitLab → Preferences → Access tokens 创: Create a personal or project access token in GitLab → Preferences → Access tokens with the api scope. The token is stored in the Keychain.
在 Gitea / Forgejo → 设置 → 应用 生成令牌，reposit: Generate a token in Gitea / Forgejo → Settings → Applications with read and write repository access. The token is stored in the Keychain.
在交易标题行末尾添加 #标签。: Adds #tag to the end of each transaction header.
在交易标题行末尾添加 ^链接，相关交易会在详情页互相显示。: Adds ^link to each transaction header; linked transactions show each other in their details.
地址填写账本所在文件夹。坚果云请在「账户信息 → 安全选项」中添加第三方应用密码: Enter the URL of the ledger folder. For Jianguoyun, create an app password under Account Info → Security. The password is stored in the Keychain.
填写金额与账户后将在此生成分录: Fill in the amount and accounts to generate the entry here
子账户会一起改名，例如 %@:Sub 变为 %@:Sub。: Sub-accounts are renamed too, e.g. %@:Sub becomes %@:Sub.
存在差额（多为外币折算或缺少价格所致）: Out of balance (usually currency conversion or missing prices)
将从账本文件中移除这一行断言。: This line will be removed from the ledger file.
将写入 %@，位于该账户已有断言之后。: Written to %@, after this account's existing assertions.
将写入一条 close 指令，此后该账户不能再有交易。: A close directive will be written; the account can have no transactions after that date.
已手动编辑 · 点按继续编辑: Edited by hand · tap to keep editing
已生成退款草稿，请核对金额后保存: Refund draft created; check the amount and save
已载入为新交易，请核对金额与日期: Loaded as a new transaction; check the amount and date
市值按账本中最新的 price 指令计算；成本取自买入时记录的 {成本}；卖出时: Market value uses the latest price directive in the ledger; cost comes from the {cost} recorded at purchase; sales reduce lots by the account's booking method (e.g. FIFO).
开启后，每天第一次打开 App 时自动获取并写入当天价格（需要联网）。: When on, today's prices are fetched and written the first time you open the app each day (needs a connection).
当前余额 %@，建议先转出或通过余额核对确认为零: Current balance %@; transfer it out or reconcile it to zero first
我 → 服务 → 钱包 → 账单 → 常见问题 → 下载账单 → 用于个人对账，: Me → Services → Wallet → Bills → FAQ → Download bills → for personal reconciliation, send to email; unzip to get an xlsx.
我的 → 账单 → 右上角 … → 开具交易流水证明 → 用于个人对账，选择时间: Me → Bills → … → Transaction statement → for personal reconciliation, choose a range and send to email; unzip to get a CSV.
截至 %@ · 原始符号（借方为正，贷方为负）: As of %@ · raw signs (debits positive, credits negative)
所在文件：%@。修改日期后将按新日期重新排序。: In %@. Changing the date re-sorts it by the new date.
按交易过滤：交易内任一分录满足即保留: Filters transactions: kept if any posting matches
按月 / 按年的分类额度与执行进度: Monthly / yearly limits per category and progress
提醒在本机生成，每次打开 App 或同步后按最新账本重新安排。: Reminders are created on this device and rescheduled from the latest ledger whenever the app opens or syncs.
支持 Beancount 查询语言（BQL）的常用子集：SELECT … FRO: Supports the common subset of the Beancount Query Language (BQL): SELECT … FROM … WHERE … GROUP BY … ORDER BY … LIMIT, plus BALANCES and JOURNAL. query directives and .bql files in the ledger are listed automatically.
未找到 %@，可在「设置 → 仓库结构」中指定主文件（如 %@）: %@ not found; set the main file in Settings → Repository Layout (e.g. %@)
未找到仓库、分支或路径（404）: Repository, branch or path not found (404)
未结转损益为期初至截止日的收入减支出（Fava 中的 Equity:Earnin: Current earnings are income minus expenses up to the date (Equity:Earnings:Current in Fava). Assets = Liabilities + Equity; other currencies are converted to %@ at that date.
来自账本（修改后可另存）: From ledger (save a copy to keep changes)
此交易由 pad 指令自动生成，如需调整请修改对应的 pad 或余额断言。: This transaction was generated by a pad directive; change the pad or balance assertion to adjust it.
清除本机缓存？同步队列中的变更将保留。: Clear the local cache? Pending changes are kept.
点按切换账本；左滑可编辑连接或删除。每个账本有独立的缓存、同步队列与仓库结构设置: Tap to switch ledgers; swipe left to edit or remove. Each ledger has its own cache, sync queue and layout settings.
点按可插入到查询末尾。: Tap to append to the query.
点按柱形查看当月明细: Tap a bar for that month
留空则根据账本自动识别：交易写入最近年度交易所在的文件（{year} 替换为年份: Leave empty to detect from the ledger: transactions go to the file holding the latest year ({year} becomes the year; a new year creates a file and adds an include to the main file); balances, prices and opens go to the file with most of their kind. After changing the main file or receivable account, tap Apply and Reload.

Leave empty to detect from the ledger: transactions go to the file holding the latest year ({year} becomes the year; a new year creates a file and adds an include to the main file); balances, prices and opens go to the file with most of their kind. After changing the main file or receivable account, tap Save and Resync above.
直接读写 WebDAV 上的账本文件夹，如坚果云、Nextcloud、群晖。: Reads and writes a ledger folder over WebDAV, e.g. Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, Synology.
直接输入 Beancount 指令，可一次输入多条，例如：\n2026-10-0:
Type Beancount directives directly, several at once, e.g.:
2026-10-08 price USD 7.10 CNY
2026-10-09 balance Assets:Cash 400.00 CNY
离线时的变更暂存于本机，恢复联网后自动提交。左滑可移除单项。: Changes made offline are kept on this device and committed when you're back online. Swipe left to remove an item.
竖线表示时间进度。预算按 Fava 的格式写在账本中：custom \"budg: The line marks how far through the period we are. Budgets are written in Fava's format: custom "budget" Account "monthly" amount; daily / weekly / quarterly / yearly budgets are scaled to the period shown.
网银或 App 中导出交易明细为 CSV / Excel(xlsx)。导入后可手: Export transactions as CSV / Excel (xlsx) from online banking. You can map the date, amount and payee columns after importing.
请在 GitHub 创建 fine-grained token：仓库范围仅选择账: Create a fine-grained token on GitHub: select only your ledger repository and set Contents to Read and write; add Actions: Read-only to see bean-check results. The token is stored in this device's Keychain.
请在系统设置中允许 Ledger 发送通知: Allow notifications for Ledger in Settings
读写「文件」App 中的文件夹：我的 iPhone、iCloud Drive，或: Reads and writes a folder in the Files app: On My iPhone, iCloud Drive, or locations from Jianguoyun, OneDrive, Working Copy and others. Changes are written straight to the files.
账户名需以五大类开头，各级以冒号分隔，每级首字母大写，如 Assets:Bank: Start with one of the five roots, separate levels with colons and capitalize each level, e.g. Assets:Bank:CMB
账本中所有出现该账户（及其子账户）的地方都会被替换，作为一次修改提交。: Every occurrence of this account (and its sub-accounts) in the ledger will be replaced in one change.
账本中没有出现该账户: The account does not appear in the ledger
账本始终为标准 Beancount 文本文件：本应用写入的内容在电脑上 git: The ledger stays plain Beancount text: anything written here shows up on your computer after git pull, and works with Fava, bean-check and other tools.
资产、负债、权益与净资产走势: Assets, liabilities, equity and net worth
近 120 天内出现 3 次及以上的交易将自动列入；置顶项优先显示，左滑可隐藏。: Transactions recorded 3 or more times in the last 120 days appear here automatically; pinned items come first, swipe left to hide.
近 180 天无待报销垫款: No unclaimed advances in the last 180 days
还没有预算。点右上角 + 为支出分类设置每月或每年的额度。: No budgets yet. Tap + to set a monthly or yearly limit for a category.
远端文件已被修改（%@），稍后将自动重试: The file changed remotely (%@); will retry automatically
连接你的 Beancount 账本：GitHub、GitLab、Gitea 仓库: Connect your Beancount ledger: a GitHub, GitLab or Gitea repository, a folder in the Files app, or WebDAV. Your data only travels between this device and the storage you choose.
连接存放于 GitHub 的 Beancount 账本仓库。账本数据仅在本机与: Connect the GitHub repository holding your Beancount ledger. Your data only travels between this device and GitHub.
连接成功，但没有找到 .bean 文件: Connected, but no .bean files were found
退款将冲减原支出科目，并通过同一 ^link 与原交易关联。: The refund offsets the original expense account and is linked to the original transaction with the same ^link.
选择包含主文件（默认 main.bean）的文件夹。用 Working Copy: Pick the folder containing the main file (main.bean by default). For a repository managed by Working Copy, commit and push from Working Copy or your computer.
选择收款账户后生成: Choose the receiving account to generate
通过 API 直接读写仓库，每次保存都是一次 Git 提交。: Reads and writes the repository through its API; every save is a Git commit.
金额按期末汇率折算为 %@。收入以正数列示。: Amounts converted to %@ at period-end rates. Income is shown as positive.
金额留空的一行将自动补平；左滑可删除。成本填写 {} 内的内容，如 180 US: A row with an empty amount is balanced automatically; swipe left to delete. Cost is what goes inside {}, e.g. 180 USD; price is @ 7.1 CNY or @@ total.
需为 Token 授予 Actions: Read-only 权限以显示 bea: Grant the token Actions: Read-only to see bean-check results
